description:
Situated in the sought-after village of Houghton, this semi-detached bungalow occupies a spacious corner plot, offering potential for extension, subject to planning permission. The property comprises a living dining room, kitchen, two double bedrooms, and a bathroom, awaiting a programme of renovation to unlock its full potential.

Houghton village is renowned for its picturesque village green, local shop, primary school, and the popular Cafe on the Green coffee shop, providing a charming community atmosphere. Excellent transport links ensure easy access to nearby amenities in Kingstown. This property presents an exciting opportunity for those with a vision to create a bespoke home in a desirable location.

Directions Head north from the city centre onto Brampton Road, take the left into the village of Houghton. Opposite the village shop take the left around the back of the village green, onto South Croft.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.

Key Information: • Standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking.
